normalization.definition: initial expected sensory-to-Core absolute current, averaged across Core cells and the entire fixed trial, including neutral baseline/cue/padding and two equally weighted visual outcomes
normalization.limits: Per-cell distribution remains sparse. Poisson refractory losses and learned weight drift are measured, not corrected using test outcomes. ON/OFF has no static current.

limits: M9 fixed 2x2: Core weights 1/4 and both existing STDP time constants 20/100ms
Core weights scale excitation and inhibition together; no new neural rule or task-specific wiring
Reference rate gain and all initial edges, cells, delays and peripheral weights held fixed within seed
Two action probes per mapping at exact training checkpoints, immediate and after independent 2s rest; no-copy controls
Core homeostasis and development off; weights frozen during evaluation; extra spikes alone are not learning
Fresh pilot and confirmation seeds; no selection or tuning between stages; factorial contrasts descriptive

limitations: Membrane and trace state preserved; tests necessity under this state and fixed decoder, not sufficiency or exclusivity of weight storage
weight_resets.readout: same training-checkpoint count decoder; no recalibration after intervention
weight_resets.restoration: condition-specific initial weights, after independent rest and before baseline
